proves.claim: A fixture gate-queued stretch with snapshots showing 3 jobs ahead, then 0 ahead with every runner in runnersSeen leased, then an empty runnersSeen, then a serveStartedAt change splits into QUEUE_DEPTH(3), NO_RUNNER_SLOT, RUNNER_DOWN and SERVE_RESTART with exact lengths.

stats.timeline.gate-wait-reasons.why: Gate queue snapshots need to explain how long a submitted item waits for a runner.

proves.claim: readItemTimeline on a real cellBoard with an offered gate job and gate-queue events returns the gate-queued row with its wait reason; pullboard timeline prints that reason unchanged.

stats.io-timeline.gate-wait-real-board.why: The reader and timeline output must preserve the queue wait reason from board events.

proves.claim: One event_kind_id indexed gate-queue read is shared across fleet items on a scratch board with 60000 gate-shard rows, 93 offered gate jobs and 20 gate-queue snapshots; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows SEARCH.

stats.io-timeline.gate-queue-index.why: A per-item scan of gate-queue history would make --fleet repeat work as the board grows.
